instruction: Enable Windows Filter Keys and keep them enabled. From El Rufai Park Bus Stop, Gwagwalada 902101, Federal Capital Territory, Nigeria, determine the nearest passport office listed in the provided Nigeria Immigration Service directory and leave Google Maps driving directions to that office visible.
gt_steps: Read the Nigeria Immigration Service passport office directory PDF.
Locate the 'Addresses of Passport Offices in the NIS' section.
Determine that the nearest passport office to El Rufai Park Bus Stop is the Abuja FCT Passport Office located on Dukpa Road, along Gwagwalada Area Council Secretariat, Gwagwalada, Abuja.
Search for the Abuja FCT Passport Office.
Set the starting location to `El Rufai Park Bus Stop, Gwagwalada 902101, Federal Capital Territory, Nigeria`.
Verify the destination is `Abuja FCT Passport Office, Dukpa Road, along Gwagwalada Area Council Secretariat, Gwagwalada, Abuja`.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$flags = [int](Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\Keyboard Response' -Name 'Flags' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if (($flags -band 1) -eq 1) { Write-Output 'FILTER_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'FILTER_KEYS_DISABLED' }"
